description: Velocity loss across a set from each rep's mean concentric velocity (from a bar-speed device or the Bodywise bar path tracker): (fastest − last) ÷ fastest, plus each rep's loss from the fastest. Reports the number with the 20% vs 40% study finding; never sets a personal cut-off.
